prompt: Sign in to the web UI as the admin user (password in secrets/reference-admin.txt).
Platform > Security > API Keys: create key 'bench' with full access. Save the secret, one line, mode 0600, to secrets/reference-api-token.txt.
Create key 'parity-ro' with read-only access. Save it to secrets/reference-api-token-2.txt. Record whether each secret was shown once.
Connections > OPC UA > Server Settings: write the current values here, then set bind 0.0.0.0, port 62541, add policy None, anonymous access on, expose tag providers on.
Turn the gateway audit profile on (record the default retention).
Do not open any trial or licensing action.
